messages.author: b0a710d3cc16379b
messages.subject: "Starting GWAS Estimation"
parts:
Hi All,

Whenever trying to run the final GWAS step

outputGWAS<-userGWAS(covstruc=LDSCoutput,SNPs=p_sumstats,estimation="DWLS",model=model,sub =c("C~SNP","NC~SNP"))# printwarn = FALSE

It will always hang at

[1] "Please note that an update was made to userGWAS on 11/21/19 so that it combines addSNPs and userGWAS."
[1] "Starting GWAS Estimation"

This is after a 24 hour run on a HPC, is it just not enough time for the program to run or could there be an underlying issue?

Thanks in advance for any help!

Kind regards,
Dominic

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: "Starting GWAS Estimation"
parts:
Hi Dominic, 

A single run of all SNPs could take 24 hours depending on the complexity of the model and the number of SNPs being analyzed. See this post on the google group for some things to consider: 
https://groups.google.com/g/genomic-sem-users/c/ZJtXg56fQsg/m/1XHglsX9BAAJ

Ideally you would want to both run in parallel and use an array or driver script to submit multiple jobs that are running in parallel. 

Best, 
  Andrew
